status.summary: No. 5 UFC featherweight on a two-fight win streak, pro record 18-3. He outpointed Arnold Allen at UFC 324 (Jan 24, 2026; 30-27, 29-28, 29-28) and submitted Jose Miguel Delgado with a one-arm rear-naked choke at 2:57 of round 3 in the Noche UFC main event (Sep 12, 2026, Glendale), after surviving an early scare; Delgado had replaced an injured Yair Rodriguez. Since Volkanovski beat Evloev at UFC 333 (Oct 24, 2026) he has campaigned for the title shot. Volkanovski's head coach said he has not earned it and prefers the winner of Sterling vs Vallejos (set for Nov 21), while a Cageside Press column called Silva the front-runner. On Nov 5 Dana White said he is open to a Volkanovski vs Justin Gaethje super-fight, pending Gaethje's decision. No bout is booked as of Nov 6, 2026 (UFCalendar; ESPN lists only his previous fight).
status.ranking: #5 featherweight (UFC media-panel rankings of Nov 3, 2026, mirrored by UFCalendar and ufcrankings.org on Nov 5-6; also #5 on the algorithmic Meta board of Oct 31); ufc.com returned 403 to scripts

injuries.what: broke both hands in the Drew Dober fight (UFC Denver), by his own account early in the bout

signature: counter left hook, thrown as the opponent steps in (dropped Charles Jourdain this way, UFC 303)
left hook into straight right to finish (Baghdasaryan, Feb 2025; knockdown of Bryce Mitchell, Apr 2025)
spinning back elbow (opened Drew Dober's brow, Jul 2024; also thrown vs Mitchell and Allen)
front-headlock 'ninja choke' / guillotine off the opponent's takedown attempt (Mitchell, UFC 314)
one-arm rear-naked choke after a knockdown scramble (Delgado, Sep 2026)
accurate body punching and kicking (22 of 23 body strikes vs Allen)
weaknesses: opponents land leg kicks almost at will: 21 of 21 (Mitchell), 8 of 8 (Allen), 18 of 22 (Delgado)
hittable in exchanges: absorbs 4.2 significant strikes per minute, 55% significant-strike defence (career)
finished once: Diego Lopes took him down and mounted him in round 1, then a spinning elbow and ground strikes stopped him at 4:48 of round 2 (Sep 2025)
hurt early by Delgado's right hand in round 1 of the Noche UFC main event (reports; ufcstats records no knockdown)
missed weight once (147.5 lb for UFC 303, Jun 2024)
style.summary: A Fighting Nerds striker who invites exchanges and hits hardest on the counter, with a low, looping lead hand that sets up the left hook and a heavy right hand behind it. He pressures, taunts and throws spinning elbows, punches the body well, and punishes takedown attempts with front-headlock chokes. The cost is a lot of incoming fire, above all to the legs.

moves.notes: Weights sum to about 1 within each target group (head, body, leg); spinning/knee/elbow are separate propensities. Target split from fighters.json career sums: 78% of significant attempts to the head, 18% body, 4% legs (landed 65/27/7); the decayed sums are nearly the same (77/18/5). The left hook gets the top head weight because Fight Primer and the Jourdain, Baghdasaryan and Mitchell finishes centre on it; the right hand is second. Head kicks were noted vs Allen but are rare (0.05). Body work is accurate (22/23 vs Allen, 13/15 vs Mitchell, 15/19 vs Dober) but no source splits kicks from punches, so body kick and body hook are even. Leg kicks are only 4% of his attempts and their type is unsourced, so calf/inside are 50/50. Spinning 0.12 reflects spinning elbows in the Dober, Mitchell and Allen fights; elbow 0.15 for the Dober cut; two finishes (Wilson, Jourdain) came from punches in the clinch. Sources: ufcstats sums in data/derived/fighters.json, per-fight rows in data/raw, Fight Primer, Cageside Press, CBS.

appearance.build: compact, muscular featherweight; 5 ft 7 in with a 69 in reach (ufcstats)
appearance.hair: dark, buzzed very short with a receding, thinning hairline (Sep 2026 ESPN headshot); a little longer in the Sep 2025 cutout. Not shaved bald, as an earlier draft had it
appearance.facial_hair: full brown beard of medium length with a moustache (Sep 2025 and Sep 2026 cutouts)
appearance.tattoos: heavily tattooed (checked against the Sep 2026 ESPN cutout): a padlock on the left upper chest and shoulder (outlets say it sits over a diamond with his mother's name), 'LORD' in large letters across the lower chest, and a black-and-grey sleeve on the left arm that joins the shoulder piece, including a date ending '12.96' and a round ornamental piece on the forearm (outlets also describe a cross in it); a fine-line floral piece on the right thigh. One outlet reports a barcode on the back of his head (single source; the back of his head is not visible in the photos used)
appearance.kit: Sep 2026 shoot (Noche UFC): black UFC (Venum) shorts with a grey wave pattern and a Noche UFC patch; Sep 2025 shoot: green Noche UFC shorts with a red-white-green waistband and SILVA down the left leg; fight-night colour follows the corner. After wins he and his team often wear the Fighting Nerds' lens-less taped glasses

engine_notes.note: Six knockdowns in 72.9 UFC minutes (one about every 12 minutes) and 4 KO/TKO wins in 8 UFC fights; knockdown power well above division norms.
Opponents' leg strikes land at a very high rate on him: 47 of 51 combined across Mitchell, Allen and Delgado. A kicking opponent should get a leg-strike accuracy bump.
Takedown defence holds against wrestlers on the feet (Mitchell 1 of 14), but once Lopes got him down (3 of 4) he landed 42 ground strikes; Silva has 0:03 control in that fight.
5-round pace in fighters.json (1, 4.4, 3.39 for rounds 1-3) comes from only two main events, in both of which he lost or struggled through round 1; treat it as noise, not a real late surge.
